A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same ChordEdit paper and complete appendices A–L. Full-text comparison and page-by-page rendering establish that the text, equations, tables and figures support reliable comparison.

before.justification: v1 reports original PIE-bench evaluations, ablations, seed-robustness analyses and a 150-participant user study in Appendix J.

after.justification: v2 retains the original PIE-bench evaluations, ablations, seed-robustness analyses and Appendix J user-study results.

M1.justification: The Chord Control Field, single-step transport, optional proximal refinement and single-/multi-noise algorithms are unchanged, including Algorithms 1 and 2.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same PIE-bench coverage of 700 images across 10 editing categories, alongside the same toy example, qualitative scenarios and user-study prompts.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged in Tables 1–4, the qualitative comparisons and the user study. The revised NFE values do not add, remove or redefine a comparison method.

E3.justification: The documented evaluation settings, metrics, models and user-study design are unchanged. The four baselines with revised NFE values remain listed at 50 steps; no procedural change accompanies these efficiency-result revisions.

E4.justification: Section 6 and Appendix F retain the same analyses of smoothing, integration steps, noise samples, refinement, backbone models and parameter sensitivity. No robustness analysis or case study is added or removed.

E5.justification: Figure 11 retains the same 20-seed histograms, across-seed envelopes and variability reporting. Statistical and uncertainty reporting elsewhere is also unchanged.

E6.justification: Tables 1 and 4 change NFE from 150 to 100 for DDIM + MasaCtrl, Direct Inversion + MasaCtrl, DDIM + PnP and Direct Inversion + PnP. Their step counts, quality scores, runtimes and VRAM values remain unchanged. All other numerical and qualitative results are retained.

T1.justification: The mathematical definitions, assumptions, derivations and proofs in Sections 3–4 and Appendices B–E are unchanged.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain the same claims about training-free, inversion-free, model-agnostic editing, low-energy transport, efficiency and preservation quality.

C2.justification: Interpretations of temporal smoothing, seed robustness and the preservation–semantics trade-off are unchanged, as are numerical-stability qualifications and societal limitations. No explanation accompanies the revised baseline NFE values.

D1.justification: Hardware, hyperparameters, implementation guidance, algorithm descriptions and code-access statements are unchanged. No additional implementation or computational-accounting details explain the NFE revisions.

R1.justification: Section 2, Appendix A and the reference list are unchanged, retaining the same citations and positioning relative to earlier editing methods.

P1.justification: The marginal arXiv stamp changes from v1 dated 22 February 2026 to v2 dated 25 March 2026. Research prose, titles, headings and section organization are unchanged.

P2.justification: v2 adds visible page numbers throughout the 33-page document. Figures, table structures, captions and placement are unchanged; the numerical table revisions are covered under E6.

improvement.justification: Pagination modestly improves navigation, but Tables 1 and 4 revise four baseline NFE counts from 150 to 100 without explaining the accounting or identifying an error. All other scientific content is unchanged. The supplied PDFs therefore leave the accuracy benefit or harm of the only substantive revision, and its net effect on paper quality, unresolved.
